name: reseassistenten
description: ReseAssistenten is a travel-planning assistant: search SAS award flights, run pre-trip readiness checks (Resekontroll), track EuroBonus status, and explore award-winning destinations — on your own account.

interface.longDescription: ReseAssistenten is a travel-planning assistant for your own account: search SAS award flights (Europe and intercontinental), run pre-trip readiness checks (Resekontroll) with entry requirements, track your EuroBonus level-point status and the cheapest way to the next tier, set award-availability watches, and explore award-winning restaurants, hotels and beaches across destinations. It connects to the hosted, per-user-authenticated ReseAssistenten MCP server over OAuth (dynamic client registration) — no tokens or secrets are stored in this plugin — and acts with exactly the permissions you have on the web.
defaultPrompt: Show my trips, check my EuroBonus status, or find SAS award seats
